title: hr_attendance — timekeeping/check-in/check-out deep L3
key_finding: Overtime computation (hr.attendance.overtime.line, hr.attendance.overtime.ruleset, hr.attendance.overtime.rule) is fully present in Odoo 19 Community — not Enterprise-only. The module ships two cron jobs for auto-checkout and absence detection, a four-level security group hierarchy, kiosk PIN protection, and worked-hours calculation that deducts lunch breaks for fixed-schedule employees.

cross_module_findings.separate_hr_attendance_overtime_module: NOT PRESENT — overtime is bundled in hr_attendance itself
cross_module_findings.barcodes_dependency: hr_attendance depends on barcodes module for RFID/badge scanning
cross_module_findings.base_geolocalize_dependency: Used for IP-to-location and GPS reverse geocoding on attendance events

groups: group_hr_attendance_own_reader: all internal users (implied by base.group_user)
